description.value: Bamboo Inn Restaurant is a well-established Chinese and Asian restaurant on Comox Avenue serving Szechuan cuisine, Pho, bubble tea, and a broad vegetarian selection. With over 513 customer reviews and online ordering with delivery, it draws regulars from across the Comox Valley. Cyclists stopping in Comox will find a full menu of hearty noodle, rice, and stir-fry dishes.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 81m; rack (4 spaces) at 81m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Bamboo Inn Restaurant is an active business at 2040 Comox Ave, Comox, BC, with matching phone and address to OSM. The 'closed at the moment' message refers to the real-time online ordering system status, not permanent closure — reviews dated as recently as May 23, 2026 confirm ongoing operation. The website explicitly lists 'Vegetarian' as a served cuisine and includes an online ordering/delivery system, but contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill.
concerns: Website displays 'We are closed at the moment. Ordering system is disabled.' on all pages — this appears to be a real-time ordering availability notice rather than a permanent closure indicator, as reviews from May 2026 confirm active operation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible restaurant with recent customer reviews confirming ongoing operation. A clear stop option for touring cyclists in Comox.
